units.source_text: 太君长叹一声，说道：“你这样深思远虑，亦自有理。

en.t: The Grand Lady sighed deeply and said, "It is true that you have reason to think so carefully and far ahead.

units.source_text: 但这里的右大将等人都以为封夕雾六位，出乎预料，正在诧异呢。

en.t: But here, the Right General and the others all find it unexpected that Yugiri has been given the Sixth Rank, and they are quite astonished.

units.source_text: 夕雾这孩子也很不高兴。

en.t: The boy Yugiri himself is also very unhappy.

units.source_text: 他一向看不起右大将和左卫门督家的表兄弟，认为他们都赶不上他。

en.t: He has always looked down on his cousins from the houses of the Right General and the Captain of the Left Gate Guard, thinking that none of them could match him.

units.source_text: 岂知他们都升了官，成了大员，而他自己还穿着淡绿袍子，心中很委屈，真可怜呢。”

en.t: Who would have thought that they would all be promoted and become important officials, while he himself is still wearing a pale green robe? He feels deeply wronged, and it is truly pitiful."

units.source_text: 源氏笑道：“小孩子家也懂得怨恨我了？

en.t: Genji laughed and said, "Has a child already learned how to resent me?

units.source_text: 不过照这年龄，也难怪的。”

en.t: Still, at his age, it is only natural."

units.source_text: 他觉得这儿子很可爱，接着又说：“多读点书，稍稍懂得人情物理之后，这怨恨自然会消解。”

en.t: He found this son very endearing, and then went on to say, "Once he reads more books and comes to understand a little about human feelings and the principles of things, this resentment will naturally fade away."
